notes.title: Pre-Release Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985022/36469e3f10abb605a3b69844c227620bda7ee125.png


With the release date within days, it seemed the game could use some minor improvements:

Image Gallery

Probably the biggest piece of work, the game now allows users to see which images they've collected and thus know if they've skipped a scene or two via their in-game choices. Should be a fun way to track if there's more to see by going back and trying to do things differently.

Content

Added 4 more images, one of them is a cover for this post. And the related short scenes to slightly increase the game's content in places that needed it, without subtantially changing the story.


Fixes

The never-ending quest to hunt typos, as well as fixing a relatively serious logic bug where one of the main choices wasn't affecting what it should.
